Its periodic signed distributional derivative is -delta_0+sum_k 2^-k delta_{{k alpha}}; the negative wraparound atom is necessary. Squared increments over a circular arc of length tau<=1/2 integrate pairwise to (tau-||a-b||)_+ and absolute convergence follows total variation 2. Diagonal mass is 4tau/3; off-diagonal lag-k atom coefficient is -2/3 *2^{1-k}, giving claimed exact delta_n. For Fibonacci n=F_j, Binet identity gives tau=phi^-j and best-approximation denominator F_{j+1} excludes every earlier correction, yielding the two explicit positive two-sided bounds. Expand stationary variance for covariance half-deficit. Ray map scales Euclidean squared return by ||v||². No off-ray assertion is proven. Independent finite-jump quadrature at j=3..6 matched formula to about 1e-11 at truncation k=35, not proof of the infinite sum.
